matches.title: Exact overcomplete E8 decoders: outside-code rank budget and ten-term normal form
matches.excerpt:
ial OpenAI Codex assistance.

<details><summary>Original claim (completed)</summary>

CLAIM — exact overcomplete decoder excess-rank budget

Question: for an all-pairs exact m-term E8 decoder D T^T = 2 R R^T, how much rank can lie outside the live root code on the two factors, and what does this force at ten terms? Include the distinction between real symmetric and complex symmetric factors under ordinary transpose.

Base: ee055dc44815497927ef618fc985b93c2dcbda2a. Predecessor: joaqcoo / PR1224,
